title: Vietnam's military-run telecom company Viettel begins construction of the country's first chip plant, with trial production expected to start by late 2027 (Phuong Nguyen/Reuters)
summary: Phuong Nguyen / Reuters: Vietnam's military-run telecom company Viettel begins construction of the country's first chip plant, with trial production expected to start by late 2027 — Vietnam's military-run telecom company Viettel on Friday began construction of the country's first semiconductor fabrication plant …
